records.text: Owens said Stephen Feinberg co-founded Cerberus Capital Management in 1992, that it managed 70 billion dollars in assets, and that DynCorp entered its portfolio in 2010.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Well, in 1992, he co-founded Cerberus Capital Management. ... Cerberus Capital Management is a fund with 70 billion AUM. That's assets that are under their management, 70 billion. ... Steven Feinberg was one half. He's a co-founder and that's why he was a controversial pick, not just because of his extraordinary wealth, but more specifically due to one particular asset which came under their management portfolio in 2010, DynCorp.

verification.notes: Official Defense and Cerberus materials confirm Feinberg co-founded Cerberus in 1992, that the firm grew to approximately 70 billion dollars in assets under his leadership, and that Cerberus affiliates completed the DynCorp acquisition in July 2010.

sources.title: Hon. Steve Feinberg official biography
sources.relevance: Confirms the 1992 Cerberus co-founding and approximately 70 billion dollars in assets under his leadership.

sources.title: DynCorp International Announces Completion of Acquisition by Cerberus Affiliates
sources.relevance: Confirms completion of the DynCorp acquisition in July 2010.

records.text: Owens said Cerberus Capital Management bought DynCorp in 2010 and owned it for the next ten years.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, when her movie about the scandal came out in 2010, DynCorp sold to Stephen Feinberg's Cerberus. It was owned by Cerberus for the next 10 years.

verification.notes: Cerberus announced completion of its DynCorp acquisition in July 2010, and Amentum announced completion of its acquisition from Cerberus in November 2020. This supports ownership for approximately ten years.

Amentum Closes DynCorp International Acquisition
sources.relevance: Confirms acquisition from Cerberus closed in November 2020.

records.text: Owens said Stephen Feinberg claimed to have divested from Cerberus Capital Management but alleged that he still had unclear financial ties to it.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I know since Stephen Feinberg. ... has said that he has divested from Cerberus Capital, but that kind of always just means like it's on hold and he still does have financial ties to them, which are unclear.

verification.notes: Official ethics documents and a 2026 Senate oversight letter show Feinberg certified divestment of Cerberus stakes while retaining or amending arrangements for Cerberus administrative services and family trusts. The public record supports the stated unresolved continuing ties caveat.

sources.relevance: Reports certified divestment alongside continuing Cerberus-linked arrangements and personnel that prompted conflict questions.
